g1|variants|third-party.summary: Third-party order processing handles customer demand where goods are procured from an external vendor who ships directly to the customer, bypassing internal inventory. Variants differ by procurement trigger timing, billing control, and returns handling.

variants.name: Standard Third-Party with Automatic Purchase Requisition (TAS)
variants.when_used: Standard customer order where the system automatically generates a purchase requisition in MM upon sales order entry for external vendor direct delivery.
variants.key_config: Item category TAS assigned to schedule line category CS, with item category group BUP or NORM and checking group set for availability/transfer.

variants.name: Third-Party with Manual Purchase Requisition (TAT)
variants.when_used: When the purchase requisition must be created or reviewed manually before triggering external procurement and vendor direct shipment.
variants.key_config: Item category TAT configured to require manual purchase requisition creation in purchasing while still driving direct delivery to the customer.

variants.name: Third-Party with Customer Returns (TAS / RE)
variants.when_used: When a customer returns goods delivered directly by a third-party vendor, requiring credit memo request generation and vendor return notification.
variants.key_config: Returns order item category configured to trigger a returns purchase requisition to the vendor and subsequent credit memo for the customer.

g1|core|third-party|standard third-party.title: Third-Party Order Processing with Automatic Purchase Requisition (TAS)
g1|core|third-party|standard third-party.story: When a customer buys something we do not stock, our system automatically tells an external vendor to ship the item directly to them and send us the bill. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash (OTC), this process creates a sales order with item category TAS, which immediately generates a purchase requisition in Materials Management (MM) to trigger the third-party vendor fulfillment.
g1|core|third-party|standard third-party.why_business_needs_it: This process allows companies to expand their product catalog and fulfill customer demands without holding physical inventory or incurring warehousing costs. It automates vendor procurement directly from sales order entry, reducing manual processing time and order-to-delivery cycles.

modules.role: Captures customer demand via sales order OR, assigns item category TAS, triggers procurement, and bills the customer based on incoming vendor invoices.
modules.hands_off_to: MM (Materials Management) to create and process the automatic purchase requisition and subsequent purchase order.

modules.role: Receives the purchase requisition from the sales order, generates the purchase order to the external vendor, and processes the vendor invoice receipt.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for vendor liability posting and customer billing generation.

modules.role: Posts vendor invoice liabilities and issues customer invoices based on order-related billing control.

prerequisites: Customer Master Data with billing and shipping partner functions created via transaction BP
Vendor Master Data for the third-party supplier created via transaction BP
Material Master Data with purchasing view and correct item category group (e.g. BSERV or NORM) created via transaction MM01
Purchasing Info Record linking material and vendor created via transaction ME11

config_steps.step: Define Item Category Determination for Third-Party Item Category TAS
config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type: OR; Item Cat. Group: BSERV; Higher Level Item Cat: blank; Default Item Cat: TAS; Item Cat. 2: TAS
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N on table TVAPF to confirm the entry exists for sales document type OR and item category group BSERV.
config_steps.why: This configuration ensures that when a sales order is created with the third-party material, the system automatically assigns item category TAS.
config_steps.if_missing: If missing, the sales order item will fail item category determination with message V1320.
actions: Enter /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter
Click the Position button on the application toolbar
Enter Sales Doc. Type OR and Item Cat. Group BSERV in the pop-up window
Press Enter to locate the entry in the table
Click New Entries on the application toolbar to add a custom row if missing, or select the existing row
Ensure Sales Doc. Type is set to OR, Item Cat. Group is BSERV, and Default Item Cat is set to TAS
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the configuration to a transport request

config_steps.step: Configure Item Category TAS Attributes for Order-Related Billing and Pricing
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item Category: TAS; Billing Category: F (Order-related); Pricing: X (Standard); Billing Relevance: F; Check Credit: X; Schedule Line Allowed: X
config_steps.check: Inspect table TVOV using SE16N to verify billing category F and pricing indicator X are set for TAS.
config_steps.why: This ensures the third-party sales order item prices correctly and generates order-related billing tied to vendor invoices.
config_steps.if_missing: If incorrect, billing cannot be generated properly from the vendor invoice receipt.
actions: Enter /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter
Select item category TAS from the list and double-click it
Locate the Billing Category field in the Billing section and set it to F
Locate the Pricing field and set it to X
Set the Billing Relevance field to F
Ensure Check Credit and Schedule Line Allowed checkboxes are selected
Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the transport request prompt

config_steps.step: Configure Schedule Line Category CS for Purchase Requisition Generation
config_steps.where: VOV6 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Define Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.values: Schedule Line Cat: CS; Order Type: 1 (Purchase Requisition); Item Category: TAS; Account Assignment Category: X (Standard); Check Disposition: blank
config_steps.check: Review table TVOZ via SE16N to ensure schedule line category CS has order type 1.
config_steps.why: This setting dictates that saving the sales order automatically triggers a purchase requisition in Materials Management (MM) for vendor fulfillment.
config_steps.if_missing: If order type is blank, no purchase requisition is generated upon saving the sales order.
actions: Enter /nVOV6 in the command field and press Enter
Select schedule line category CS and double-click to open details
Set the Order Type field to 1
Set the Item Category field to TAS
Set the Account Assignment Category field to X
Ensure Check Disposition is blank
Save (Ctrl+S) and save the changes into your customizing request

config_steps.step: Assign Schedule Line Category Determination for Item Category TAS
config_steps.where: VOVO -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Schedule Lines > Assign Schedule Line Categories
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Assign Schedule Line Categories": Overview
config_steps.values: Item Category: TAS; Schedule Line Category Mapping: CS
config_steps.check: Create a test sales order item with category TAS and verify that schedule line category CS defaults automatically.
config_steps.why: This links the sales item category to the procurement schedule line category during sales document processing.
config_steps.if_missing: If unassigned, the sales order item will lack a schedule line category and cannot be saved.
actions: Enter /nVOVO in the command field and press Enter
Click Position and search for Item Category TAS
Verify if schedule line category CS is mapped to Item Category TAS and MRP type
Click New Entries if the combination does not exist
Enter Item Category TAS and MRP Type as blank or standard
Enter Schedule Line Category as CS
Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm transport prompt

config_steps.step: Maintain Purchasing Info Record for Third-Party Material and Vendor
config_steps.where: ME11 -- Logistics > Materials Management > Purchasing > Master Data > Info Record > Create
config_steps.screen_title: Create Purchasing Info Record: Initial Screen
config_steps.values: Vendor: 100000; Material: Third-party material; Purchasing Org: 1000; Info Category: Standard
config_steps.check: Run transaction ME13 to display the created purchasing info record and confirm pricing and vendor details are active.
config_steps.why: This master data link allows the purchase requisition generated from the sales order to pull the correct vendor and pricing automatically.
config_steps.if_missing: Without an info record, the generated purchase requisition may lack a source of supply and vendor pricing.
actions: Enter /nME11 in the command field and press Enter
Enter Vendor number 100000
Enter the Third-party material number
Enter Purchasing Organization 1000
Select Info Category as Standard
Press Enter to proceed to the purchasing data screen
Enter Planned Delivery Time, Standard PO Quantity, and Net Price, then Save (Ctrl+S)
